questions.question: The average temperature on Friday, Saturday and Sunday was 26∘ and on Saturday, Sunday and Monday it was 24∘. If on Monday it was exactly 25∘. Then what was the temperature on Friday?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Average temperature on Friday, Saturday and Sunday = 26°

Average temperature on Saturday, Sunday and Monday = 24° 

Temperature on Monday = 25° 

**Formula Used:**

Average = frac{{Sum of values}}{{Number of values}}

**Calculation:**

Sum of temperatures on Friday, Saturday and Sunday = 3 × 26° 

⇒ Sum of temperatures on Friday, Saturday and Sunday = 78° 

Sum of temperatures on Saturday, Sunday and Monday = 3 × 24° 

⇒ Sum of temperatures on Saturday, Sunday and Monday = 72° 

Temperature on Friday = Sum of temperatures on Friday, Saturday and Sunday + Temperature on Monday - Sum of temperatures on Saturday, Sunday and Monday

⇒ Temperature on Friday = 78° + 25° – 72°

⇒ 103° – 72°

⇒ 31°

**∴ Temperature on Friday is 31°**

questions.question: A player has a certain average for 15 innings. In the 16th inning, he scores 120, thereby his average increased by 6 runs. What is the new average?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The score in the 16th innings is 120

The increase in average is 6

**Formula Used:**

Total score = Average × No. of Innings

**Calculations:**

Let the initial average be ‘k’

⇒ New average = k + 6

⇒ Total Score after 15 innings = 15k

⇒ Total Score after 16 innings = 16(k + 6) = 16k + 96

⇒ 15k + 120 = 16k + 96

⇒k = 24

⇒ k + 6 = 24 + 6 = 30

∴ New Average = k + 6 = 30

questions.question: In a company with 600 employees, the average age of the male employees is 42 years and that of the female employees is 41 years. If the average age of all the employees in the company is 41 years 9 months, then the number of female employees is:
questions.solution:
**Solution:**

**Given data: **

No. of employees in company = 600

The average age of the male employees = 42 years

The average age of the female employees = 41 years

The average age of all the employees in the company = 41 years 9 months

⇒ (41 + 9/12) years

⇒ 167/4 years

**Concept used:**

Average = (Sum of all cases)/(Number of cases)

**Calculation:**

Let no. of male employees be x.

⇒ No. of female employees = 600 – x.

Sum of ages of all male employees = x × 42

⇒ 42x years ----(1)

Sum of ages of all male employees = (600 – x) × 41

⇒ (24600 – 41x) years ----(2)

Sum of ages of all employees = 42x + 24600 – 41x ----(Adding equation 1 and 2)

⇒ (x + 24600) years ----(3)

Sum of ages of all employees = 600 × 167/4

⇒ 25050 years ----(4)

Equating equations 3 and 4

⇒ x + 24600 = 25050

⇒ x = 450

⇒ No. of male employees = 450

⇒ No. of female employees = 600 – 450

⇒ 150

**∴**** The number of female employees in the company is 150.**

 

**Alternate method:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e54c8c6a47e1cb7d25f43874e6b9af3f711ee6754a5b3d9b56dab9cf7e15703d.png] 

No. of male employees: No. of female employees = 3 : 1

⇒ No. of male employees = 3x

⇒ No. of female employees = x

⇒ Total no. of employees = 4x

⇒ 4x = 600 ----(given data)

⇒ x = 600/4

⇒ x = 150

⇒ No. of female employees = x = 150

 

**∴ The number of female employees in company is 150.**

questions.question: In a set of three numbers, the average of the first two numbers is 7, the average of the last two numbers is 10, and the average of the first and the last numbers is 14. What is the average of the three numbers?
questions.solution:
**Given: **

The set of three numbers, the average of the first two numbers is 7, the average of the last two numbers is 10, and the average of the first and last numbers is 14.

**Concept: **

Average = (Sum of all observation/Number of observation)

**Calculation: **

Let the set of three number is respectively a, b, and c.

According to the question

The sum of first number is 

⇒ a + b = 2 × 7

⇒ a + b = 14 ----(1)

The sum of the last two number is 

⇒ b + c = 2 × 10 

⇒ b + c = 20 ----(2)

The sum of the first and last number is 

⇒ c + a = 2 × 14

⇒ c + a = 28 ----(3)

Add eq. (1), (2) and (3) 

⇒ 2(a + b + c) = 14 + 20 + 28

⇒ (14 + 20 + 28)/2

⇒ 62/2

⇒ 31

So,

The average of the three number is 

⇒ 31/3

**∴ The required average is 31/3. **

**Short approach:**

The average of the three numbers is 

⇒ (7 + 10 + 14)/3

⇒ 31/3

∴ The required average is 31/3.

questions.question: The number of students in section A and section B of a class are 40 and 52, respectively. The average score in mathematics of all the students is 75. If the average score of the students in A is 20% more than that of students in B, then what is the average score of students in B?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of students (A : B) = 40 : 52 = 10 : 13

Ratio of average scores (A : B) = 120 : 100 = 6 : 5

Weighted average parts = (10 × 6 + 13 × 5) ÷ (10 + 13) = 125/23 parts

Given, 125/23 parts = 75 ⇒ 1 part = (75 × 23) ÷ 125 = 13.8

Average score of students in B = 5 × 13.8 = 69 marks

**∴ The correct answer is 69 marks.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number of students in A (nA) = 40

Number of students in B (nB) = 52

Total Average Score = 75

Average A is 20% more than Average B.

**Formula Used:**

Total Average = (Sum of scores in A + Sum of scores in B) ÷ Total students

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5175d58f0b80421b48f280298406570c3a9b2870c1988c68d1b3cbe9c3482092.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the average score of students in B = x

⇒ Average score of students in A = x + 20% of x = 1.2x

⇒ Total sum of scores = (40 × 1.2x) + (52 × x)

⇒ Total students = 40 + 52 = 92

⇒ Average = Sum ÷ Count ⇒ 75 = (48x + 52x) ÷ 92

⇒ 75 = 100x ÷ 92

⇒ 100x = 75 × 92

⇒ 100x = 6900

⇒ x = 69 marks

**∴ The correct answer is 69 marks.**

**__Additional Information__**

Weighted Average Formula

The combined average of two groups is given by Aₐvg = (n₁a₁ + n₂a₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂), where n is the number of items and a is the individual average.

Alligation Rule

The ratio of the quantities is inversely proportional to the deviation of their averages from the mean average: n₁ ÷ n₂ = (a₂ − Aₐvg) ÷ (Aₐvg − a₁).

Percentage Change in Averages

If an average increases by k%, the new average is A × (1 + k/100). For 20% more, the multiplier is 1.2.</p

questions.question: The average of twenty-five numbers is 54. The average of the first 13 numbers and that of the last 13 numbers is 52.8 and 62.2, respectively. If the 13th number is excluded, then what is the average of the remaining numbers (correct to one decimal place)?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Net deviation for the middle (13th) number = 13 × [(52.8 − 54) + (62.2 − 54)]

Net deviation = 13 × [−1.2 + 8.2] = 13 × 7 = 91

Value of 13th number = 54 + 91 = 145

Sum of remaining 24 numbers = (25 × 54) − 145 = 1350 − 145 = 1205

New Average = 1205 ÷ 24 = 50.208... ≈ 50.2

**∴ The correct answer is 50.2.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total numbers (n) = 25

Total Average (A) = 54

Average of first 13 = 52.8

Average of last 13 = 62.2

**Formula Used:**

Total Sum = Average × Number of terms

Value of repeated term = (Sum of subgroups) − (Total Sum)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/806ba95511bd7bf3248f1d8c9f586f534634d2ae2ae51f163ab9fd7cd5592ea6.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total Sum of 25 numbers = 25 × 54 = 1350

⇒ Sum of first 13 numbers = 13 × 52.8 = 686.4

⇒ Sum of last 13 numbers = 13 × 62.2 = 808.6

⇒ Sum of (13 + 13) numbers = 686.4 + 808.6 = 1495

⇒ Value of 13th number = 1495 − 1350 = 145

⇒ Sum of remaining 24 numbers = 1350 − 145 = 1205

⇒ Average of 24 numbers = 1205 ÷ 24

⇒ Average ≈ 50.208

**∴ The correct answer is 50.2.**

**__Additional Information__**

Net Deviation Concept

The sum of deviations of all observations from their arithmetic mean is always zero. If a term is repeated, the net deviation is the value by which the sum increases.

Exclusion Principle

When a value is excluded, the new average = (Original Total Sum − Excluded Value) ÷ (Original Count − 1).

Weighted Average

If groups with different averages are combined, the overall average = (n₁A₁ + n₂A₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).</p

questions.question: The average of 50 number is 36. If two numbers, namely 63 and 65 are discarded, the average of the remaining numbers is (Correct to two decimal places)
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Average of 50 number is 36.

**Formula used:**

Average = Sum of values/number of values

**Calculation:**

Average of 50 number = 36

Sum of 50 number = 36 × 50 = 1800

Two number 63, and 65 discarded

Sum of left 48 numbers = 1800 - 63 - 65 = 1672

Average of Left 48 numbers

⇒ 1672/48

⇒ 34.83

**∴ The average of remaining numbers is 34.83.**

questions.question: The average marks of 42 students in an examination, was 64. Later it was found that the marks of three students were misread as 72, 58 and 44 instead of the actual marks 64, 42 and 26 respectively. What is the correct average marks?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The average marks of 42 students in an examination = 64

**Formula Used:**

Average of a given Terms/Series/Values = (Sum of the given Terms/Series/Values) / (Number of Terms/Series/Values)

**Calculation:**

Total Marks = 42 × 64 = 2688

⇒ Later it was found that the marks of three students were misread as 72, 58, and 44 instead of the actual marks

64, 42, and 26 respectively

**∴**** the Actual Average is = {2688−(72+58+44)+(64+42+26)}/42 = 63**

questions.question: The numbers 24, 45, a, 35, 59, 83, 46, b, 29, 74 are serially numbered as they appear in the sequence. When each number is added to its serial number, then the average of the new numbers formed is 55. The average of the missing numbers (a and b) is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The given numbers are 24, 45, a, 35, 59, 83, 46, b, 29, 74

Average of 10 numbers when each number is added to its serial number = 55

**Formula:**

Average = Sum of all observations/total number of all observations

**Calculation:**

New numbers are when each number is added to its serial number

(24 + 1), (45 + 2), (a + 3), (35 + 4), (59 + 5), (83 + 6), (46 + 7), (b + 8), (29 + 9), (74 + 10)

According to the question

(24 + 1) + (45 + 2) + (a + 3) + (35 + 4) + (59 + 5) + (83 + 6) + (46 + 7) + (b + 8) + (29 + 9) + (74 + 10) = 55 × 10

⇒ 450 + a + b = 550

⇒ a + b = 550 - 450

⇒ a + b = 100

∴ Average of a and b = 100/2 = 50

questions.question: The captain of a cricket team of 11 members is 28 years old and the wicket keeper is 4 years older than him. If the ages of these two are excluded, the average age of the remaining players is two years less than the average age of the whole team. What is the average age of the team?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Age of captain = 28 years

Age of wicket keeper = 4 years older than the captain = 32 years

Average age of team without captain and wicket keeper = Average age of whole team – 2

**Formula used:**

Average age = Sum of ages of all players/Number of players

**Calculations:**

Let the sum of ages of all players is T and average age of whole team be A

⇒ A = T/11

⇒ T = 11A

Average age when captain and wicket keeper excluded = A – 2

⇒ A – 2 = (T – 28 – 32)/9

⇒ 9A – 18 = T – 60

⇒ 9A – 18 = 11A – 60

⇒ 2A = 42

⇒ A = 21

**∴**** T****he average age of the team is 21 years**
